BiblicalUsage: The word hinnêh is behold, lo — a small word, used 799 times; Genesis and Exodus show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hinnêh needs no more than its plain sense — behold, lo.
RelatedEvents: Creation; Moses' Birth and Flight to Midian
